occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The date the last children's products certification form was signed was on 5/2/24. Todays  date is 5/22/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Upon reviewing children's records, three out of 10 records reviewed did not address the Physician's Health Statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: A 4 month old infant was laying in her crib and was in a swaddling sleep sack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A drawer that was accessible to children had an ointment inside that is supposed to be kept out of the reach of children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 3 year old child in care was left behind by staff, in a public bathroom/locker room. Child was left unsupervised for approximately 11 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: Two children with a diagnosed food allergy do not have the food allergy plans posted in their room and any other room where they might be in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During the inspection, I overheard a staff member yell at a child/children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: 3 staff were present without the completed background check requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left in a room unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: An employee did not show good judgment when she picked up a child by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Employees were not appropriately supervising children when they were seen on their personal phones during a field trip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Children Identified with Center: Children were on a field trip and did not have anything on them identifying them to the daycare.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Children Identified with Center (26 TAC §746.3001(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not demonstrate good judgement when a child climbed up on chairs that were stacked. Staff saw the child and went to her but did not pick up the child to remove her off the chairs. Staff stood in front of the chairs until when the child fell from the chairs, causing her to hurt herself. When asked why she did not pick up the child, she stated that she does not like to lay hands on the children and will give them their space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Upon reviewing children's records, 10 out of 10 children's records did not include an address for the emergency contact.
